Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

Keep the supplied language.", "input": "for friday's greenhouse watering rota, please assign Orson to check the seedling benches at A169 no sorry i mean B61 before the first watering round. he should use the narrow-can spout there, because the new trays are close together, and water each tray slowly until the compost is damp but not pooled. then record any dry trays on the blue clipboard by the west door, don't move the clipboard into the potting room because the afternoon team looks for it there. the first round should begin at 7:15, and the glasshouse vents need to stay open while he's working unless the outside temperature drops below 12 degrees. if a hose is still connected across the center aisle, leave it where it is and use the cans instead, so nobody has to step over it with a full load. please leave the second round on the rota for 11:30, but don't assign that one to Orson; Mara is covering it. that's all, and make a note if any bench is still dry when the round is finished.", "output": "For Friday's greenhouse watering rota, please assign Orson to check the seedling benches at B61 before the first watering round. He should use the narrow-can spout there, because the new trays are close together, and water each tray slowly until the compost is damp but not pooled. Then record any dry trays on the blue clipboard by the west door. Don't move the clipboard into the potting room, because the afternoon team looks for it there. The first round should begin at 7:15, and the glasshouse vents need to stay open while he's working unless the outside temperature drops below 12 degrees. If a hose is still connected across the center aisle, leave it where it is and use the cans instead, so nobody has to step over it with a full load. Please leave the second round on the rota for 11:30, but don't assign that one to Orson; Mara is covering it. Make a note if any bench is still dry when the round is finished."}]
